definitions.explanation: Medicine used to treat symptoms of the common cold, such as runny nose, cough, and fever.

examples.japanese: {風邪薬|かぜぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦{寝|ね}た→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
examples.english: I took cold medicine and went to bed.

examples.japanese: {風邪薬|かぜぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}く→眠い：00872_nemui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{喉|のど}→喉：00977_nodo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{鼻水|はなみず}→鼻水：04430_hanamizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧{風邪薬|かぜぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for cold medicine that works for sore throat and runny nose.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧ (cold) + ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧ (medicine). The ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧ becomes ぐすり due to rendaku (sequential voicing).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {風邪薬|かぜぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to take cold medicine
- {風邪薬|かぜぐすり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧: cold medicine works/takes effect
- {風邪薬|かぜぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy cold medicine

USAGE:
Available in tablet (⟦{錠剤|じょうざい}→錠剤：17290_jouzai⟧), powder (⟦{粉薬|こなぐすり}→粉薬：27515_konagusuri⟧), and liquid (⟦{液体|えきたい}→液体：04134_ekitai⟧) forms. Many {風邪薬|かぜぐすり} cause drowsiness (⟦{眠気|ねむけ}→眠気：06534_nemuke⟧), which is a common topic of conversation.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧: common cold
- ⟦{解熱剤|げねつざい}→解熱剤：09713_genetsuzai⟧: fever reducer
- ⟦{咳止|せきど}め→咳止め：27038_sekidome⟧: cough suppressant
- ⟦{市販薬|しはんやく}→市販薬：09834_shihanyaku⟧: over-the-counter medicine
